Abdulkerim Bardakci.note: What separates Bardakcı is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Bardakcı holds the route into the box until support arrives. Also note how he steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Abdulkerim Bardakci.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Abdülkerim Bardakcı踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Altay Bayindir.note: Bayındır's signature is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. Watch how he keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. At another point in the move, he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Altay Bayindir.noteZh: 观察Altay Bayındır时，可以先看射门方向明确前保持身体平衡。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。另一个比赛细节是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Arda Guler.note: Watch Güler for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. The clearest example is how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Also notice how Güler moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Arda Guler.noteZh: Arda Güler的优势在于比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。最直接的表现是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个值得观察的细节是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Baris Alper Yilmaz.note: The key to Yılmaz is using strength without slowing the next action. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. In another phase, Yılmaz moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Baris Alper Yilmaz.noteZh: Barış Alper Yılmaz的比赛建立在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步之上。首先看他如何承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。另一个方面是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Caglar Soyuncu.note: For Söyüncü, the foundation is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. Look first at how he turns early and protects the route toward goal. A separate point is how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Caglar Soyuncu.noteZh: 最能体现Çağlar Söyüncü特点的是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。除此之外，他也会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Can Uzun.summary: Can Uzun is a Türkiye attacking midfielder from Eintracht Frankfurt who gives the national team between-lines receiving, sharp shooting, and young creative upside.
Can Uzun.note: The key to Uzun is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. One more thing to notice is how Uzun shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Can Uzun.noteZh: 观察Can Uzun时，可以先看狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。另一个比赛细节是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Deniz Gul.note: Watch Gül for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate clue is how Gül angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Deniz Gul.noteZh: 最能体现Deniz Gül特点的是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。这一点直接体现在他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Eren Elmali.note: Elmalı's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Another detail is how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Eren Elmali.noteZh: 观察Eren Elmalı时，可以先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个比赛细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ferdi Kadioglu.note: What separates Kadıoğlu is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Kadıoğlu draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. A separate detail appears when he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ferdi Kadioglu.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Ferdi Kadıoğlu踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Hakan Calhanoglu.note: Çalhanoğlu stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. A different detail is how Çalhanoğlu uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Hakan Calhanoglu.noteZh: Hakan Çalhanoğlu的比赛建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球之上。首先看他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个方面是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Irfan Can Kahveci.summary: İrfan Can Kahveci is a Türkiye right winger from Kasımpaşa who gives the national team left-footed crossing, combination play, and set-piece quality.
Irfan Can Kahveci.note: For Kahveci, the foundation is delivering the ball without needing much space. Look first at how he looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. Also watch how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Irfan Can Kahveci.noteZh: 很小空间里也能送出传中的能力是理解İrfan Can Kahveci踢法的关键。先看他如何在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。到了另一个比赛环节，他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Ismail Yuksek.note: Yüksek stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A different detail is how Yüksek angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ismail Yuksek.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢是理解İsmail Yüksek踢法的关键。先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Kaan Ayhan.note: The key to Ayhan is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. A separate part of his game is how Ayhan holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kaan Ayhan.noteZh: 多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构是理解Kaan Ayhan踢法的关键。先看他如何改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。到了另一个比赛环节，他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Kenan Yildiz.note: For Yıldız, the foundation is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Look first at how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. A separate point is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Kenan Yildiz.noteZh: 理解Kenan Yıldız，要先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Kerem Akturkoglu.note: For Aktürkoğlu, the foundation is explosive speed once open grass appears. Look first at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Beyond the first action, he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Kerem Akturkoglu.noteZh: Kerem Aktürkoğlu的优势在于看到空当后的爆发速度。最直接的表现是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个值得观察的细节是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Merih Demiral.note: Demiral's signature is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. Watch how he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. Away from that moment, he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Merih Demiral.noteZh: Merih Demiral的优势在于争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。最直接的表现是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。另一个值得观察的细节是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mert Gunok.note: Watch Günok for staying ready through long quiet spells. The clearest example is how he keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. Also watch how Günok keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled.
Mert Gunok.noteZh: 理解Mert Günok，要先看长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。

Mert Muldur.summary: Mert Müldür is a Türkiye right-back from Fenerbahçe who gives the national team full-back defending, recovery speed, and back-post coverage.
Mert Muldur.note: What separates Müldür is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Müldür holds the route into the box until support arrives. Away from that action, he checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Mert Muldur.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢构成Mert Müldür踢法的核心。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，值得留意他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Oguz Aydin.summary: Oğuz Aydın is a Türkiye right winger from Fenerbahçe who gives the national team one-on-one dribbling, acceleration, and direct crossing.
Oguz Aydin.note: Aydın stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Aydın also looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Oguz Aydin.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Oğuz Aydın踢法的关键。先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Orkun Kokcu.summary: Orkun Kökçü is a Türkiye central midfielder from Beşiktaş who gives the national team progressive passing, midfield shooting, and press-resistant control.
Orkun Kokcu.note: What separates Kökçü is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Kökçü takes the first available forward lane before it closes. At another point, he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Orkun Kokcu.noteZh: Orkun Kökçü最鲜明的特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。一个直接线索是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个独立细节是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ozan Kabak.summary: Ozan Kabak is a Türkiye centre-back from TSG Hoffenheim who gives the national team aggressive duels, aerial defending, and recovery cover.
Ozan Kabak.note: The key to Kabak is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate part of his game is how Kabak turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ozan Kabak.noteZh: 理解Ozan Kabak，要先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Salih Ozcan.summary: Salih Özcan is a Türkiye defensive midfielder from Borussia Dortmund who gives the national team screening, duels, and disciplined possession support.
Salih Ozcan.note: Özcan stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Özcan also holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Salih Ozcan.noteZh: 观察Salih Özcan时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Samet Akaydin.note: For Akaydin, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond the first action, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Samet Akaydin.noteZh: Samet Akaydin的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Ugurcan Cakir.summary: Uğurcan Çakır is a Türkiye goalkeeper from Galatasaray who gives the national team shot stopping, penalty-area command, and long distribution.
Ugurcan Cakir.note: Watch Çakır for command of the crowded space around goal. The clearest example is how he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. Also notice how Çakır chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Ugurcan Cakir.noteZh: 掌控门前拥挤空间的能力是理解Uğurcan Çakır踢法的关键。先看他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Yunus Akgun.note: Akgün's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Watch how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Away from that moment, he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Yunus Akgun.noteZh: 观察Yunus Akgün时，可以先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个比赛细节是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Zeki Celik.note: Çelik's signature is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Watch how he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. At another point in the move, he protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Zeki Celik.noteZh: 封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者是理解Zeki Çelik踢法的关键。先看他如何靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。到了另一个比赛环节，他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。
